profile.about: Hi, I'm Rudransh. An AI/ML engineer with substantial experience of 7+ years in writing clean & structured code. I design, build & deploy autonomous systems that scale. My field of research and interest lie in Deep Neural Networks, Multi-Agent Autonomous Systems, LLMs & Reinforcement Learning. I like Calculus & Cats, and also frequently contributing to open source development. Feel free to check out my work, blog or maybe just sign the guestbook, eh?
